mapper.select: SELECT id,member_id AS publisherMemberId,SUBSTRING(name,1,257) AS name,product_type AS productType, config_version AS configVersion,del_flag AS delFlag FROM cms_topic WHERE id=#{topic} AND member_id=#{actor} AND del_flag=0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT id AS roleId,topic_id AS roleTopicId,slot AS roleSlot,entity_type AS entityType, entity_id AS entityId,status AS roleStatus,declared_by AS declaredBy,created_at AS createdAt FROM product_role WHERE topic_id=#{topic} AND slot='CONTENT' AND status=1 ORDER BY id LIMIT 2 FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,owner_member_id AS ownerMemberId,business_type AS businessType,status,version,payload_hash AS payloadHash FROM content_draft WHERE id=#{draft} AND owner_member_id=#{actor} FOR UPDATE
